title: proportionality: over-justification of spec-mandated slug truncation
description: Block 2 spends 2 sentences verifying that the 50-char slug truncation landed on a word boundary and is readable. The spec mandates the rule mechanically; no verification or rationale is needed. Example: 'The fix_branch slug truncation rule (50 chars) results in slug ... which is a complete word boundary. No ambiguity in the branch name; the truncated slug is still readable.'
proposed_resolution: Add a note to the thinking-block guidelines in push_thinking_blocks that mechanical spec-mandated operations (slug computation, timestamp formatting, UUID generation) require no reasoning — apply and proceed without commentary.
